entries.text: Approval flow: work items from staff stay drafts until a lead approves them, and pending items are locked against edits.
Approval queue page, plus Approve and Reject in the work-item menu.
Divisions with departments as children; Super Admins can manage positions and divisions.
Cross-division requests, intake and assignment flow.
Chat: direct messages, channels, calls and unread badges.
Wiki: access control per folder, materials and a management console.
Deadline reminders, Google Calendar sync and division dashboards.
God Mode: member editor, organisation console and refreshed instance, trash and audit pages.
New work items are assigned to their creator by default.
Super Admins can create projects and invite members.
Archive and delete are hidden unless the assignee is you or someone you lead.
Yorukaze branding removed from the app and the public portal.
Work items now return their real assignees, so owners can open their own tasks.
Trash restore and permanent delete follow the same ownership rules as work items.
Super Admins can decide the approval queue; the queue endpoint no longer errors.
Translations bundle again after the locales link was restored.
